title: Why the First Generations Lived Long: The Descent of Rule
description: In the beginning the powers ruling the cosmic circuit were the lords of the year (the inmost, most comprehensive degree). As the ages have passed, authority has descended through month, day, hour, and moment, so that lifespan, stature, fertility, light, and life of human generations have shrunk in exact proportion to the descent of governance from inmost to ultimate — the progressive externalization of the human race.
